pose_en: Side view (slightly three-quarter) of one woman sitting upright on the edge of a flat weight bench, feet flat on the floor, knees at 90 degrees, back straight. She holds one dumbbell in each hand just in front of her shoulders at shoulder height, PALMS FACING EACH OTHER (neutral grip, dumbbells vertical, parallel to each other), elbows bent and pointing FORWARD in front of the body. NOT palms forward, NOT dumbbells held sideways. One straight arrow above the dumbbells points UP toward the ceiling.

Side view of one woman standing upright beside a simple chair, one hand resting on the chair backrest for balance. An elastic resistance band is looped around the ankle of her working leg; the other end of the band runs under the sole of her standing foot, which holds it on the floor. Both legs straight and next to each other, knees side by side. NOT a cable, NOT a machine, NOT an anchor behind her. One curved arrow behind the working lower leg points from the heel up and back toward the buttock.

Side view of one woman lying on her back on an exercise mat. Her HEAD AND SHOULDERS are clearly LIFTED off the mat, chin slightly tucked, looking toward her knees. Both hips and knees are bent at 90 degrees in a tabletop position, shins parallel to the floor, both hands resting on the knees. NOT head on the mat, NOT a leg already straight. One straight arrow next to the lower leg points diagonally forward and down, away from the body, showing one leg about to stretch out.

Front view of one woman standing FREELY on a half-ball balance trainer with the round dome side UP and the flat side on the floor. One foot is in the middle of the dome, knee slightly bent; the other foot is lifted a little off the dome, knee bent. Arms slightly out to the sides for balance, trunk upright. NO rail, NO bar, NO support, nothing to hold. One small curved double-headed arrow near the standing ankle indicates keeping balance.

Three-quarter front view of one woman sitting upright on a simple chair, feet flat on the floor, hands resting on her thighs, shoulders relaxed. A small card with a single capital letter A hangs on the wall STRAIGHT IN FRONT of her at eye level, and her eyes look directly at it. Head facing straight ahead. NOT the card to the side. One curved DOUBLE-HEADED arrow above her head shows the head turning left and right.

Three-quarter front view of one woman standing upright, feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at her sides. A small card with a single capital letter A hangs on the wall STRAIGHT IN FRONT of her at eye level, and her eyes look directly at it. Head facing straight ahead. NOT the card to the side. One curved DOUBLE-HEADED arrow above her head shows the head turning left and right.

Side view of one woman lying with her belly and hips on a large exercise ball, legs stretched out behind her with the toes on the floor, feet hip-width apart. Her upper body is relaxed and ROUNDED FORWARD DOWN over the ball, head low toward the floor in front of the ball, arms crossed in front of her chest. NOT already in a straight line. One curved arrow above her upper back points up and backward, showing the trunk lifting until it is in line with the legs.

Front view of one woman standing upright, feet hip-width apart, holding one dumbbell in her RIGHT hand hanging straight down along the side of her thigh. Her LEFT hand rests ON HER LEFT HIP (hand on the waist, elbow out to the side). NOT an arm above the head, NOT the free arm hanging. One curved arrow beside her right side points down along the dumbbell side, showing the trunk bending sideways toward the dumbbell.

Front view of one woman sitting upright on a chest-fly machine seat, back against the backrest, feet flat on the floor. Her arms are out to the sides with the ELBOWS BENT AT ABOUT 90 DEGREES at chest height, upper arms horizontal, forearms vertical against the two padded arms of the machine, hands holding the handles. NOT straight arms. Exactly ONE curved arrow in front of her chest shows the arms moving together toward the front.

Three-quarter front view of one woman sitting upright on a simple chair, feet flat on the floor. Her RIGHT hand is placed behind her lower back. Her LEFT hand rests on the back of her head. Her head is turned about 45 degrees to the LEFT, AWAY from the right side, and tilted down so her nose points toward her LEFT armpit. One short curved arrow near the left hand points down and forward toward the left armpit.

Three-quarter front view of one woman standing upright, feet hip-width apart. Her RIGHT hand is placed behind her lower back. Her LEFT hand rests on the back of her head. Her head is turned about 45 degrees to the LEFT, AWAY from the right side, and tilted down so her nose points toward her LEFT armpit. One short curved arrow near the left hand points down and forward toward the left armpit.
